Definition: burning, i.e. (figuratively) poisonous (serpent); specifically, a saraph or symbolical creature (from their copper color)
BiblicalUsage: 1) serpent, fiery serpent; 1a) poisonous serpent (fiery from burning effect of poison); 2) seraph, seraphim; 2a) majestic beings with 6 wings, human hands or voices in attendance upon God
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
